name: swizzler
description: Read your Swizzler cocktail library — search recipes, see what you can make, and check what's queued up next.
long_description:
Swizzler keeps your cocktail recipes on your iPhone in SwiftData, synced through your private CloudKit database — neither of which a desktop MCP server can reach. Instead, the app publishes a photo-free snapshot of your library to its own iCloud Drive folder when you enable Settings → Claude Access → Share with Claude. This bundle reads that snapshot.

It is read-only; nothing here can change your library.

The snapshot only refreshes while Swizzler is running, so every result states how old the data is and warns rather than answering as if stale data were current. If recipes look wrong or missing, ask it to diagnose sync.
